title: Naresh Shridhar Mirajkar v. State of Maharashtra

content.caseIdentity: Naresh Shridhar Mirajkar v. State of Maharashtra, AIR 1967 SC 1
content.holding: A judicial order passed by a court of competent jurisdiction cannot be challenged under Article 32 as violating Fundamental Rights.
content.relevance: Judiciary in its judicial capacity is not amenable to Article 32 writs.
